checks.text: The page shows the heading "Pomodoro Timer", the text "Focus", and the time display "25:00".
Clicking the button "Start" changes the phase label to "Focus", the time display to "24:59" within one second, and the button label to "Pause".
Clicking "Pause" freezes the time display at its current value, changes the button label to "Resume", and clicking "Resume" resumes the countdown from that frozen value.
Clicking the button "Skip" during a running Focus phase changes the phase label to "Break" and resets the time display to "05:00".
After a Focus phase completes naturally (time reaches "00:00"), the phase label changes to "Break", the time display resets to "05:00", and a toast message "Focus session completed" appears.
Clicking the tab "History" shows a list of completed sessions; after completing one Focus session, the list contains an item with the text "Focus" and a duration of "25:00".
Clicking the button "Copy summary" on the History tab copies the text "Sessions: 1, Total focus: 25:00" to the clipboard and shows a toast "Copied to clipboard".
The streak display shows "Streak: 0" initially; after completing one Focus session, it shows "Streak: 1".
Reload keeps the completed session: after completing one Focus session and reloading, the History tab shows an item with "Focus" and "25:00", and the streak display shows "Streak: 1".
